title: Claude Code's Chrome Extension: What Works and What Doesn't
summary: Joseph Fluckiger tries the Claude Code Chrome extension on real tasks and reports what worked.

chapters.title: Demo: Trigger an Error and Read the Console
Slides Workaround and Personal Data Warning

learn: The beta extension lets Claude Code drive your own Chrome with your live sessions, for live debugging, design verification, authenticated web app testing and data extraction.
It uses Chrome native messaging and a tab group that limits which tabs the extension can reach; setup is the latest Chrome and Claude Code plus a chrome argument.
What worked: on a local FastAPI app it clicked a button to trigger an error and read the console; it found a BYU vs. Baylor ticket page and stopped short of buying.
What did not: it usually refused to edit a Notion page, stalled on creating Google Slides, was slow and used a lot of tokens; local Claude Code built a PowerPoint instead.
Tips: modal dialogs can interrupt JavaScript, use fresh tabs when it gets stuck, and set site permissions. Claude warns against sharing personal information such as finances.
